chunks.subject: AP English Language
chunks.title: Row A — Thesis (0–1 pt)
chunks.content: PLACEHOLDER — replace with the official College Board wording. Award 1 point only for a defensible thesis that analyzes the writer's rhetorical choices (not merely restating the prompt, summarizing the passage, or describing rhetorical choices without a line of reasoning). Award 0 for a thesis that only restates the prompt, is off-topic, or makes no defensible claim about the writer's choices.

chunks.subject: AP English Language
chunks.title: Row B — Evidence & Commentary (0–4 pts)
chunks.content: PLACEHOLDER — replace with the official wording for the 0–4 scale. 4: specific evidence supports all claims in a line of reasoning AND commentary explains how the writer's rhetorical choices contribute to the argument, purpose, or message. 3: adequate evidence and explains how some choices contribute. 2: some evidence, mostly general, commentary mostly restates evidence. 1: minimal or irrelevant evidence, summary rather than analysis. 0: no defensible support.

chunks.subject: AP English Language
chunks.title: Row C — Sophistication (0–1 pt)
chunks.content: PLACEHOLDER — replace with official wording. Award 1 point for demonstrating sophistication of thought and/or a complex understanding of the rhetorical situation — e.g. explaining the significance or relevance of the writer's choices, situating the argument in a broader context, or using a vivid and persuasive style. Award 0 for oversimplified claims, style that does not enhance the argument, or unsupported grand generalizations.
